Subject: Panel matrix proposal + candidate availability (Elena Park)

Morning team — looping you all in to lock the virtual loop for Elena (SWE, backend infra). Candidate summary: strong distributed systems background, available next week windows listed below. I put together a suggested panel matrix and a staggered two-wave cadence to avoid long contiguous blocks for interviewers. Please open the attached matrix and flag conflicts.

Key constraints:
- Candidate timezone: PST (San Francisco)
- Prefer two 90-min windows rather than a full 4-hr block
- Need separate design+system deep-dive + pairing + leadership conversation

Suggested slots (PST):
- Wave A: 2028-11-30 10:00–11:30 (Design deep-dive + System Q&A)
- Wave B: 2028-11-30 14:00–15:30 (Pairing exercise + Leadership)

I attached panel_matrix_v2.xlsx with interviewer mapping and a fallback rotation if someone drops. Can Marissa own calendar invites and Naomi own the pairing environment (codesandbox + shared repo)? Laura, can you be debrief owner?

Attachments: panel_matrix_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Best,
Jonas
Lead, Platform Growth
Redwood Inference

A couple of notes:

- For the pairing exercise, I can use a shared GitHub repo or a simple whiteboard + VS Code Live Share — whichever the interviewer prefers.

Also added my recruiter from Acme Talent Partners in case any paperwork needs to move before then.
